description: Traverse and compile a bounded subsection of a website (such as an API reference or documentation folder) starting from a seed URL. Returns consolidated page summaries and navigable resource URIs.

exclude_paths.description: Path glob patterns to exclude from compilation (e.g. ['/changelog/**', '/**/pricing']).

include_paths.description: Path glob patterns to restrict compilation (e.g. ['/docs/api/**', '/reference/**']).

max_depth.description: Maximum link hop depth from seed URL.

max_pages.description: Maximum number of pages to discover and compile.

url.description: Starting seed URL for the crawl.

name: atlas_crawl

crawl_id.description: Atlas job identifier for tracking crawl status and reading results via atlas://crawls/{id}.

summary_markdown.description: Structured Table of Contents and synopsis of crawled pages within context budget.
